privileged_info_for_vlm: The source file is 'ProjetoJupiter_Valetudo_2019.ork'. The agent must create a 'Science Payload' mass component. Output files must be: '~/Documents/exports/payload_curve.csv' (with headers Payload_Mass_kg,Apogee_m,Max_Mach), '~/Documents/exports/payload_summary.txt' (containing the average loss calculation), and '~/Documents/rockets/valetudo_payload_4kg.ork'. The average loss formula is (Apogee@1kg - Apogee@4kg) / 3.
